armed-conflicts.headline: Intensified fighting in DRC and Ukraine, missile incidents in Poland
armed-conflicts.summary: Heavy fighting in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri and North Kivu provinces has disrupted Ebola response efforts, with the WHO chief calling for peace amid ongoing violence involving the M23 armed group and ISIL-affiliated groups. Concurrently, Russian strikes in Ukraine killed civilians and hit infrastructure, while a Russian warship was struck in Libya, and Russian missiles were found in Poland, escalating regional tensions.

human-rights.headline: Gaza deemed toxic wasteland; AI safety and digital rights concerns rise
human-rights.summary: Oxfam reported that Israel's military assault has turned Gaza into a toxic wasteland, threatening human survival and constituting environmental war crimes. Globally, the UN and Barbados are co-hosting a summit on AI safety, while a major Microsoft data breach and new Australian defence laws raise significant digital rights, surveillance, and privacy concerns.

climate-events.headline: COP31 ends in failure amid fossil fuel dispute; Gaza faces environmental crisis
climate-events.summary: The COP31 climate talks in Antalya, Türkiye, ended without an overarching political agreement, as countries, including the EU and island nations, opposed a draft text that lacked a pledge to phase out fossil fuels. This failure, coupled with Oxfam's report on Gaza becoming a toxic wasteland due to military assault, highlights a severe global climate and environmental crisis.
